resources.name: Fridge to Recipes API
resources.description: API requests with after-response assertions. Run validation requests without provider access. Success requests call the configured recipe provider.

resources.name: Successful requests
resources.description: Requires a configured server and working provider access. These requests may incur provider usage charges.

resources.name: Input validation
resources.description: Expected HTTP 400. These requests do not call the recipe provider.

resources.name: Manual server configuration
resources.description: Run separately. Stop the server, start it without OPENAI_API_KEY (including values loaded from .env), then send this request. Restore configuration afterwards.

resources.name: Missing server API key
resources.description: Expected HTTP 503. Requires restarting the server without OPENAI_API_KEY; do not run alongside successful requests.
